_doc: R26-3 (task #412) — A/B/B/A paired judge config: confirms R25-5/R26-1's latency/decommit finding (cap 4->8 eliminates the decommit-driven slowdown) through the REAL #[global_allocator] entry point. The two arms are near-identical binaries whose ONLY difference is POOL_SEGMENTS (4 baseline vs 8 candidate); the shared churn-with-teardown@1024B workload is byte-identical between them, so any wall-clock/decommit delta the judge resolves is attributable to that one knob. Driven by: node scripts/paired-ab-runner.mjs --config docs/perf/r26_3_run.json --arms cap4,cap8

sanity._doc_sanity: Both arms install a REAL SeferAlloc #[global_allocator] and run a workload that reserves segments, so BOTH must report segments_reserved_total > 0 (unlike the built-in sefer-vs-mimalloc profile where only the sefer arm is nonzero).
